{{Top|leg}}

The '''First Tree''' was an element of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] religion. In his speech to [[Chirpa/Legends|Chief Chirpa]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] reminded him that [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], seen by the Ewoks as the [[Golden One/Legends|Golden One]], was prophesied to return to them since the First Tree and that they should believe him and join the fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="ROTJ Novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' (novelization)]]</ref>
